scope: QR signature, Wallet token security, replay/OCR/tamper/double-tap/race attacks
threat_model_axes: A1: clipboard replay (mobile -> kiosk scanner) — same code reused indefinitely
A2: screenshot OCR — screenshot of QR on phone, presented at kiosk later or by different person
A3: localStorage tamper — modify cached balance / loyalty_code in mobile UI
A4: double-tap redeem — two rapid POST /loyalty/redeem requests with same code, same amount
A5: browser-back mid-wizard — kiosk wizard rolls back after redeem, points already deducted
A6: cross-surface race — earn from POS while redeem in progress on kiosk
A7: QR enumeration — kiosk:order token compromise enables mass loyalty_code scanning

QR_signature.claimed: SHA-256 mock signature client-side (mobile/data/loyalty.js:168 'V0 backend scan() strips FK: prefix and matches loyalty_code — IGNORES signature')
QR_signature.actual: ABSENT — LoyaltyController::scan (line 611) does `if (stripos($raw, 'FK:') === 0) $code = substr($raw, 3)` then User::where('loyalty_code', strtoupper($code))->first(). NO signature parsing, NO nonce verification, NO TTL check.
QR_signature.verdict: P0 — control absent. QR is non-revocable plaintext credential. Mobile 5min rotation is purely cosmetic UX.

QR_TTL.claimed: 5min refresh in mobile useLoyaltyQR hook (chained setTimeout, refresh 60s before expires_at)
QR_TTL.actual: Client-side timer only. Server accepts any FK:<code> regardless of mobile-stamped expires_at. expires_at not transmitted to server in scan request.
QR_TTL.verdict: P0 — TTL is UX only, not security boundary.

controls_inventory.loyalty_code_format: 8 alphanum (uppercase). Generated at register time. UNIQUE on users.loyalty_code. Enumeration space = 36^8 = ~2.8 trillion, but real-world distribution is sparse — actual customer codes likely guessable via username/phone pattern. No rate limit on /loyalty/scan beyond throttle:20,1 per token.

auth_layer.scan_endpoint: auth:sanctum + throttle:20,1 + inline tokenCan('kiosk:order') check (LoyaltyController:579). Token compromise gates entire scan endpoint.
auth_layer.redeem_endpoint: auth:sanctum only (routes/api.php:1278). NO throttle. Inline check: isKiosk = tokenCan('kiosk:order') OR isStaff = hasAnyRole. Customer-self-redeem allowed via caller->id === user->id.
auth_layer.check_endpoint: auth:sanctum + throttle:10,1 (1271). Strongest control of read endpoints.
auth_layer.register_endpoint: PUBLIC (no auth) + throttle:5,1 (1272). Acceptable for new customer self-registration.
auth_layer.opt_in_endpoint: PUBLIC + throttle:5,1 (1319). RGPD consent + LoyaltyConsent ledger.

race_protection.redeem: DB::transaction + lockForUpdate on User row (LoyaltyController:273-323). Multiple-of-rate validation (line 294) prevents micro-transactions.
race_protection.earn: Atomic UPDATE WHERE loyalty_points_awarded IS NULL AND status != CANCELED (AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery:52-56). Sentinel -1 = in-flight; only one concurrent process wins.

idempotency.claimed: Mobile sends Idempotency-Key header on /loyalty/redeem (mobile/data/loyalty.js:24, B-02)
idempotency.actual: Route /loyalty/redeem at api.php:1278 has middleware ['auth:sanctum'] ONLY — IdempotencyKeyMiddleware NOT applied. DB transaction prevents the visible race but does NOT prevent the same key being used at a different time to produce two ledger rows for legitimate distinct attempts.
idempotency.verdict: P1 — route-level idempotency missing; defensive depth absent.

controls_inventory.wallet_token_security: N/A — Apple/Google Wallet not implemented. WALLET_PLAN.md spec calls for RS256 JWT (Google) + pkpass signing (Apple). When implemented: use AsymmetricKey signing, never HMAC short-key. CVE-2025-45769 mitigated by RS256.
controls_inventory.consent_audit: LoyaltyConsent table records ip_hash + ua_hash + privacy_notice_version on opt-in. GDPR-compliant trail.
controls_inventory.ledger_immutability: loyalty_transactions has no DB trigger preventing DELETE/UPDATE. Migration 2026_03_26_075919 added UNIQUE constraint (verify content). NOT chain-signed like audit_logs.

findings.title: QR code signature is unverified server-side — payload is non-revocable plaintext credential
findings.exploit: Attacker captures FK:A1B2C3D4 from a victim's mobile screen (screenshot, OCR, clipboard read on shared device, photo of QR shown to friend, NFC-side-channel on shared phone). Attacker presents same code at any kiosk via the legitimate kiosk scanner. Backend matches loyalty_code directly, returns balance + customer_token, allowing the attacker to redeem the victim's points up to the rate limit. The 5min mobile rotation does NOTHING — server has no notion of rotation.
evidence: mobile/data/loyalty.js:166-168 — 'V0 backend scan() strips FK: prefix and matches loyalty_code — IGNORES signature'
mobile/WALLET_PLAN.md:51 — Wallet pass barcode.message = 'FK:<loyalty_code>' (saved permanently in Apple/Google Wallet)
mobile/components/LoyaltyQR.jsx — QR visual rotates but payload is static FK:<loyalty_code> for V0
controls_missing: No HMAC-keyed signature verification on scan endpoint
No once-only flag on (user_id, nonce) pair to prevent replay
findings.recommendation: P0 FIX: implement /loyalty/qr/sign endpoint returning {payload, signature, expires_at, nonce}. Modify scan() to parse payload as JSON or signed-string, verify HMAC via config('app.key'), reject if expires_at < now() OR nonce already consumed. Wallet pass barcode should embed signed JWT, not raw FK:code. Mobile useLoyaltyQR already wired to consume {payload, signature, expires_at} — only backend implementation missing.

findings.title: /loyalty/redeem lacks route-level Idempotency-Key enforcement
findings.exploit: Network retry on slow mobile connection causes browser to re-POST /loyalty/redeem. Both requests share the same Idempotency-Key from mobile client (B-02 spec). Without middleware enforcement, server processes them as distinct transactions. DB::transaction + lockForUpdate serializes them, but BOTH succeed if balance still >= pointsToRedeem after first decrement (e.g. user had 500 pts, redeems 100 -> 400 -> retry decrements again -> 300 — DOUBLE REDEEM, two ledger rows). Effectively a double-spend on retry.
evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/LoyaltyController.php:273 — DB::transaction wraps single redeem, no key check
mobile/data/loyalty.js:24 — 'Idempotency-Key header on /loyalty/redeem (B-02)' — client sends but server ignores
findings.controls_missing: IdempotencyKeyMiddleware applied to /loyalty/redeem route. Middleware exists in app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php (FROZEN list per CLAUDE.md §7) — need to ADD it to redeem route group, not modify middleware.
findings.recommendation: P1 FIX: change route to ->middleware(['auth:sanctum', 'idempotency']) for /add-points and /redeem. Existing IdempotencyKeyMiddleware uses (branch_id, user_id, hash(key)) scope per CLAUDE.md §9 — no modification needed.

findings.title: loyalty_transactions ledger is not append-only enforced
findings.exploit: Compromised DB credential (e.g. via misconfigured ENV) allows DELETE/UPDATE on loyalty_transactions. No DB trigger SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' on DELETE (unlike audit_logs per CLAUDE.md §8). Fraud history can be silently erased.
evidence: app/Models/LoyaltyTransaction.php (standard Eloquent Model, no UseDeleteRestricted trait)
CLAUDE.md §8 — only audit_logs + z_reports have BEFORE DELETE triggers
findings.controls_missing: DB trigger BEFORE DELETE ON loyalty_transactions; revoke DELETE GRANT from app DB user.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2: add migration creating trigger. NOT NF525-mandatory (loyalty is not fiscal) but increases customer-fraud-investigation trust.

findings.title: localStorage account cache enables UX-level balance tampering
findings.exploit: Mobile data layer (mobile/data/loyalty.js:128 DEFAULT_ACCOUNT) caches account state including balance. User opens DevTools, modifies window.LC.loyalty.account.balance = 99999. Re-renders show inflated balance. NOT exploitable for actual redemption (server enforces real balance at /loyalty/redeem) but enables social engineering screenshots (e.g. fake balance shown to scam friends/family) — already mitigated by adv-A2 spec which detects screenshot patterns.
findings.recommendation: Already covered by adv-A3 test. No additional control needed; document as known UX-level limitation.

findings.title: Kiosk token compromise = unlimited loyalty enumeration via /loyalty/scan
findings.exploit: Compromised kiosk:order token (e.g. via XSS on kiosk machine, physical access, or token leak in logs) enables attacker to POST /loyalty/scan with arbitrary FK:<code> values. Throttle 20/min per token means 1200/hour, 28800/day — enough to enumerate ~28800 codes per stolen token per day. Combined with LCS-S-001, attacker can drain identified accounts.
findings.recommendation: P2: tighten throttle to 5/min for repeated 'customer_not_found' responses (adaptive throttle). Add Sanctum token IP-binding (refuse token if IP shifts). Audit kiosk token rotation cadence (currently 480min TTL per CLAUDE.md §9).

findings.title: Wallet integration not yet implemented — when added, must use RS256
evidence: mobile/WALLET_PLAN.md:146 — 'CVE-2025-45769 N/A for RS256 (Google Wallet mandate)' — correct design intent
findings.recommendation: Pre-emptive: when implementing GoogleWalletService, use firebase/php-jwt:^7.0 with RS256 only. Apple pkpass: sign with valid Apple Developer cert (never test/self-signed in prod). Document key rotation policy.

cross_surface_test_coverage.kiosk_loyalty_double_redeem_refused: tests/Feature/KioskLoyaltyDoubleRedeemRefusedTest.php (exists — verifies race protection at DB layer)
missing: No cross-surface chain test: 'earn-from-POS -> Mobile-balance-shows -> Kiosk-redeem -> Web-history-includes'
No QR-replay test: 'mobile generates QR -> snapshot -> 10min later kiosk scans snapshot -> server accepts (BAD) or rejects (GOOD)'
No screenshot-OCR test simulating image capture + retransmission
No idempotency test asserting 2x POST /loyalty/redeem with same key produces 1 ledger row

verdict: SECURITY: 1 P0 (LCS-S-001 QR signature absent), 1 P1 (LCS-S-002 idempotency route gap). 3 P2 + 1 P3. The P0 is the cornerstone finding — QR replay is the dominant cross-surface fraud vector and currently has zero server-side control. P1 idempotency fix is straightforward (route middleware add). Recommend OWNER GATE before V1 ship: confirm QR signature is V1 mandatory OR accepted V1 risk with mitigation plan.
